entry.title: Smartphone Ban Robs Afghan Female Journalists of a Vital Working Tool
entry.summary:
KABUL, October 8 (IPS) - It has become difficult for Afghan journalists to obtain information from the authorities, who are permitted to use smartphones only with special authorization. This ban particularly affects women, for whom face-to-face interviews are not an option.
